## Functions

### createCloudflareCarrier()

```ts
function createCloudflareCarrier(options): Promise<CloudflareCarrier>;
```

Construct one owner per Durable Object. Forward its native alarm to `alarm`.
Acceptance commits the Email, recipient Messages, Watchdog job and wake
together.

### cloudflareEmailTransport()

```ts
function cloudflareEmailTransport(binding): (email) => Promise<SendEvidence>;
```
